title: Odal Node Evidence Dossier v1
description: A self-contained, signed snapshot of a passport's full proof chain — see EVIDENCE-DOSSIER.md for the full specification, trust model, and rationale.

didDocuments.description: Keyed by DID. Always contains at least manifest.issuerDid.

auditEntries.description: The full hash-chained audit trail, ascending timestamp order.

transferChain.description: Present iff the passport has ever changed responsible operator. A dpp-domain core type — not strict here; see EVIDENCE-DOSSIER.md's Strictness section on why input_fidelity exists.

eolEvent.description: Present iff the passport was declared end-of-life.

checkpoint.description: Always null in v1 — the signed-checkpoint layer is not yet built. Present as a field for forward compatibility.

calcReceipts.description: Always empty in v1 — dpp-calc invocation is not yet wired end to end.

componentGraph.description: The recursive component-tree (bill-of-materials) verification report. Present iff the passport declares componentRefs; absent for a unit with no modelled sub-assemblies. Attested via manifest.contentHashes like every other member.

qualifiedSeal.description: The eIDAS qualified seal over the full-payload signature, plus signedOverJws and payloadHash so a verifier holding only this document has the CAdES and the preimage to check it against. Present iff the passport carries a seal; absent — never a placeholder — while one is queued or when no QTSP is configured. Not reachable any other way from a dossier: the seal is stripped from every audience view, including publicView and fullView, because it covers the full-payload signature rather than any redaction. The dossier holds it as an untyped object, which is why api/components/schemas/evidence/QualifiedSealMember.yaml is marked UNCHECKED in the contract suite; giving it a Rust type would close both.
